name: ckb
description: Turn one or more repositories, plus their architecture docs, diagrams, cloud IaC and CSPM results, into a cited knowledge graph and knowledge base (HLD/LLD, cross-repo flows, outputs and conditions, documented-vs-observed drift), with an interactive viewer, MCP server, impact and taint queries, a STRIDE threat model, scanner-ready context.md files, and a static supply-chain and prompt-injection audit. Auto mode selects everything from the code. Read-only on targets.
